text_markup: Creating a hosting relationship moves the hosted object to the same zone as the host. If the hosted object is subsequently moved to another zone or hosted on a different card, the hosting relationship ends.
text_plain: Creating a hosting relationship moves the hosted object to the same zone as the host. If the hosted object is subsequently moved to another zone or hosted on a different card, the hosting relationship ends.

examples.text_markup: The Runner uses the action on {card:Madani}, choosing 2 programs in their grip to host on {card:Madani}. The chosen cards change zones, moving from the Runner's grip to the play area.
examples.text_plain: The Runner uses the action on Madani, choosing 2 programs in their grip to host on Madani. The chosen cards change zones, moving from the Runner's grip to the play area.
